description: Ministry of Defence - Declaring a period of time from 25.04.2016 to 06.05.2016 for handing over he firearms without Licences
reasoning: This gazette notification declares a period for surrendering unlicensed firearms under the Firearms Ordinance, making it a legal/regulatory matter. It cites specific legislative authority (Section 30 of the Firearms Ordinance and various amending acts) and establishes a regulatory framework for compliance. While it mentions the Minister of Defence by name, it does not describe his portfolio responsibilities or make personnel changes - the focus is entirely on establishing a legal procedure and regulatory requirement.
